description: Screen a registered company and its current people of record (give state and number from search_companies), or a single name (give name and kind), against the OpenSanctions default collection (sanctions and other watchlists) and its politically exposed persons (PEP) list. Matching is by exact normalized name, including 'Last, First' forms; each hit carries the list entry, its datasets and an OpenSanctions link. A hit may be a different person or entity and no match is not a clearance — for human review, not FCRA-covered decisions. Costs $0.01 per call from the usage balance (less on paid plans); an outage is reported as an error and not charged.

kind.description: What the single name is (default company)

name.description: A single name to screen instead of a company
